promptVersions.body:
Navigate to the SMS tab any time you want to locate the details of a specific text message.


You'll notice List Views for All, Incoming, Outgoing, and Scheduled. Create new List Views of your own by clicking the gear icon drop-down and selecting New. You'll be able to filter based on Gateway, Status, Created Date, Message, and more.


Clicking on an SMS Number will take you to the details of that specific text message.


TIP: If you scheduled a message, you'll notice it has a Status of Scheduled. Made a mistake in scheduling? Simply click on the SMS Number, modify your Scheduled Date and save the record. Your message will now be delivered at the modified time.
promptVersions.title: Find any text with ease...
